emails.subject: URGENT: Q4 Budget Review Needed by EOD

emails.body:
Hi,

Thanks for your email. We can definitely help with the API integration. Here's our proposed timeline:

Week 1: Requirements gathering
Week 2-3: Development
Week 4: Testing and deployment

We'll need access to your staging environment. Can we schedule a kickoff call next Tuesday?

Best,
John
